// data.jsx — mock torrent data + live simulation helpers for torrnet
// Exports to window: TORRENTS, makeFileTree, makePeers, makeTrackers,
//   fmtBytes, fmtSpeed, fmtEta, stepTorrent, CLIENTS, COUNTRIES

(function () {
  const GiB = 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
  const MiB = 1024 * 1024;

  function fmtBytes(b) {
    if (b == null) return "—";
    if (b >= GiB) return (b / GiB).toFixed(2) + " GB";
    if (b >= MiB) return (b / MiB).toFixed(1) + " MB";
    if (b >= 1024) return (b / 1024).toFixed(0) + " KB";
    return b + " B";
  }
  function fmtSpeed(bps) {
    if (!bps) return "0 KB/s";
    if (bps >= MiB) return (bps / MiB).toFixed(1) + " MB/s";
    if (bps >= 1024) return (bps / 1024).toFixed(0) + " KB/s";
    return bps + " B/s";
  }
  function fmtEta(sec) {
    if (sec == null || sec === Infinity) return "∞";
    if (sec <= 0) return "—";
    if (sec < 60) return Math.round(sec) + "s";
    if (sec < 3600) return Math.floor(sec / 60) + "m " + Math.round(sec % 60) + "s";
    if (sec < 86400) return Math.floor(sec / 3600) + "h " + Math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60) + "m";
    return Math.floor(sec / 86400) + "d " + Math.floor((sec % 86400) / 3600) + "h";
  }

  function makePeers(t) {
    const n = t.status === "downloading" || t.status === "seeding" ? Math.max(t.peers, 6) : 0;
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const seg = () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 255);
      out.push({
        ip: `${seg()}.${seg()}.${seg()}.${seg()}`,
        country: COUNTRIES[i % COUNTRIES.length],
        client: CLIENTS[Math.floor(Math.random() * CLIENTS.length)],
        prog: Math.random(),
        down: Math.random() > 0.4 ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 3 * MiB) : 0,
        up: Math.random() > 0.5 ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 800 * 1024) : 0,
        flags: Math.random() > 0.6 ? "↑↓ E" : "↓",
      });
    }
    return out;
  }

  function makeTrackers(t) {
    const base = [
      { url: "udp://tracker.opentrackr.org:1337/announce", status: "working" },
      { url: "udp://open.demonii.com:1337/announce", status: "working" },
      { url: "udp://tracker.torrent.eu.org:451/announce", status: "working" },
      { url: "http://retracker.local/announce", status: "not working" },
      { url: "[DHT]", status: "working" },
      { url: "[PeX]", status: "working" },
      { url: "[LSD]", status: "working" },
    ];
    return base.map((b) => ({
      ...b,
      seeds: b.status === "working" && t.progress < 1 ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) + t.seeds : (b.url.startsWith("[") ? "—" : 0),
      peers: b.status === "working" ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 60) + t.peers : 0,
      leeches: b.status === "working" ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) : 0,
    }));
  }

  // advance a torrent one tick (~1s); returns new partial fields
  function stepTorrent(t) {
    if (t.status !== "downloading" && t.status !== "seeding") {
      return { down: 0, up: 0 };
    }
    if (t.status === "seeding") {
      const up = (1.5 + Math.random() * 2.5) * MiB;
      return { up, down: 0, ratio: +(t.ratio + up / t.size * 0.01).toFixed(2) };
    }
    // downloading
    const jitter = 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8;
    const down = Math.min((8 + Math.random() * 6) * MiB, 18 * MiB) * jitter;
    const up = (0.2 + Math.random() * 0.5) * MiB;
    let progress = t.progress + down / t.size;
    let status = t.status;
    if (progress >= 1) {
      progress = 1;
      status = "seeding";
    }
    return {
      down: progress >= 1 ? 0 : down,
      up,
      progress,
      status,
      ratio: +(t.ratio + up / t.size).toFixed(2),
      peers: Math.max(2, t.peers + Math.round((Math.random() - 0.5) * 4)),
      seeds: Math.max(0, t.seeds + Math.round((Math.random() - 0.5) * 3)),
    };
  }

  Object.assign(window, {
    TORRENTS, makePeers, makeTrackers, stepTorrent,
    fmtBytes, fmtSpeed, fmtEta, CLIENTS, COUNTRIES,
  });
})();
